ambiguities.fragment: System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems and allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.
ambiguities.explanation: The pronoun 'their' in 'downstream systems' can refer to either 'System-A's own downstream systems' or 'the systems of the entities that work with System-A'. This creates two distinct interpretations based on the antecedent.
possible_interpretations: System-A must add System-B to their own downstream systems and allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.
System-A must add System-B to the downstream systems of the entities that work with System-A and allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.
